categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches test framework core files test_node.py and test_framework.py to adjust polling frequencies and wait loops.
categories.rationale: Reduces test suite runtime across CI and local environments by 9% to 20% by cutting idle sleep intervals in sync helpers and RPC readiness waits. The category explicitly values test speed that every contributor pays for on every run, and the measured savings represent an important performance gain for test execution.
